brief: This one is the harness, not the town. Every worker row in RUNLOG.jsonl reads secs=0, costUsd=0, turns=0, tokens=null, so the one metric this loop exists to catch — cost per iteration climbing while output stays flat — cannot be read at all. The cause is mechanical: the worker runs runlog.mjs itself and commits the row, so when run-loop.sh afterwards calls runlog.mjs with --elapsed, --raw and --pre-blob, it hits the 'already recorded — nothing to append' guard at runlog.mjs:55 and exits, throwing the only row that has real numbers away. Make the runner's call win — a later call carrying real metrics should MERGE into the existing row for that iter+kind rather than refuse, and a row must never be duplicated. While you are in the file: drop the illegal '-- courtyard.html' pathspec from the two-blob diff at runlog.mjs:72 (git rejects a pathspec on a blob-to-blob diff, so srcLines has always silently come from the HEAD~1 fallback that the comment above it calls unreliable), and fall back to HEAD~1's blob when --pre-blob is empty so a hand-invoked iteration stops scoring itself no-ship regardless of what it shipped. Last, iteration 9 left probes/parapet-and-boat.mjs at the repo root where an unanchored .gitignore line swallowed it — it is cited in the ledger and absent from the repo. Move it into the skill's probes/ and drop that gitignore line, or delete it.
successLooksLike: stall.mjs --report shows real minutes and real dollars for worker rows. Prove it on this iteration's own row: a second runlog.mjs call carrying --elapsed and --raw updates the row in place instead of refusing, and the file gains no duplicate.
avoid: Do not touch courtyard.html — which means the evidence verdict will read no-ship for this iteration, correctly, and you should NOT touch the source to game that; say so in the ledger and move on. Do not rewrite the nine historical zero-cost rows: they are honest records of a broken instrument. Back-filling them from ~/Library/Logs/courtyard-grow.log is optional and clearly marked if you do it. Do not add a new log file.
